id: 04_Fire Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Safety Officer Interview Question
title: 安全知识问答：燃烧、火灾分类与灭火器（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/04_Fire Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Safety Officer Interview Question.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/04_Fire Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Safety Officer Interview Question（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，旁边立着一个灭火器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium next to a red fire extinguisher and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天讲消防！
overlay: 安全知识问答：燃烧、火灾分类与灭火器

shots.scene: 火焰、分类图标、灭火器、PASS手势四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a flame, a grid of six class icons, a fire extinguisher and a hand squeezing a lever. No people.
shots.narration: 火怎么来，分几类，怎么灭。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起实验室墙边的灭火器，翻来覆去看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a fire extinguisher from the lab wall bracket and turns it around, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿起灭火器：这能灭所有火吗？

shots.scene: 小研指着墙上并排的两种灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at two different extinguishers mounted side by side on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：不同的火，要用不同的灭火器。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 我们从火是什么讲起。

shots.scene: 一团火焰，周围有热浪和光线图标
shots.prompt_en: A flame with heat wave icons and light ray icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 火，是一种剧烈的化学反应。

shots.scene: 燃料、氧气、温度三个图标汇聚成火焰
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a log, an oxygen bubble and a thermometer, merge together into a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 燃料、氧气和温度一起，放出热和光。

shots.scene: 四个图标：木块和油桶、空气、火柴、连环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a wood block with a fuel can, an air swirl, a lit match and a chain of looping arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 起火要四样东西同时具备。

shots.scene: 小研指着实验台上的酒精瓶和加热板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a solvent bottle and a hot plate on a lab bench.
shots.narration: 实验室里的溶剂、空气和热源，就是例子。

shots.scene: 三角形三条边分别是燃料、热量、氧气图标
shots.prompt_en: A triangle whose three sides show a fuel icon, a heat icon and an oxygen icon, with a flame in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 火三角：燃料、热量、氧气。

shots.scene: 三角形旁写着一个旧书图标
shots.prompt_en: The triangle icon next to an old book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这是较早的说法，只讲三个要素。

shots.scene: 三角形立起来变成四面体，底面是连环箭头
shots.prompt_en: The triangle folds up into a tetrahedron; the new bottom face shows looping chain arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 火四面体：再加上链式反应。

shots.scene: 房间三个角分别有燃料、热源、氧气图标，中间没有火
shots.prompt_en: A simple room with a fuel icon in one corner, a heat icon in another and an oxygen icon in a third; the middle is empty with no flame. No people.
shots.narration: 三样东西分开放，不发生反应就不着。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头竖起四根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and holds up four fingers.
shots.narration: 四个要素缺一个，火就烧不起来。

shots.scene: 六个方块图标排成两行，分别是固体、液滴、气体、金属块、闪电、油锅
shots.prompt_en: Six square icons in two rows: a wood block, a liquid drop, a gas cloud, a metal bar, a lightning bolt and a frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 火灾按燃烧物分成六类。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank standard booklet.
shots.narration: 国内火灾分类标准也是这六类。

shots.scene: 纸张、木头、橡胶、塑料图标着火
shots.prompt_en: Icons of paper, wood, rubber and plastic each with a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: A类：固体火，纸、木、橡胶、塑料。

shots.scene: 实验室纸箱和擦拭纸堆在一起
shots.prompt_en: A pile of cardboard boxes and paper towels in a lab corner with a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里的纸箱、擦拭纸都是。

shots.scene: 汽油桶、油漆罐、溶剂瓶图标着火
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuel can, a paint can and a solvent bottle each with a flame. No people.
shots.narration: B类：液体火，汽油、油漆、有机溶剂。

shots.scene: 气瓶和燃气罐图标，阀口有火焰
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gas cylinder and a small gas canister with a flame at the valve. No people.
shots.narration: C类：气体火，如甲烷、丙烷、丁烷。

shots.scene: 金属块图标着火，旁边是钠、钾的元素方块
shots.prompt_en: A metal chunk icon with a flame, next to two blank element tiles. No people.
shots.narration: D类：金属火，如钠、钾等活泼金属。

shots.scene: 试剂柜里一个密封罐，标有遇湿危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: A sealed container in a chemical cabinet with a flame-over-water style hazard pictogram on a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 化学实验室里，真的会有金属火。

shots.scene: 电脑、配电箱、电焊机图标冒火，带闪电标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a computer, an electrical panel and a welding machine with flames and lightning bolt symbols. No people.
shots.narration: E类：带电设备着火。

shots.scene: 电源开关被拉下，闪电图标消失
shots.prompt_en: A main power switch is pulled down and the lightning bolt icon disappears from the burning device. No people.
shots.narration: 断电以后，就按燃烧物本身来处理。

shots.scene: 油锅着火图标
shots.prompt_en: A frying pan icon with oil burning on top. No people.
shots.narration: F类：烹饪用油和油脂着火。

shots.scene: 五个灭火器图标并排，铭牌空白
shots.prompt_en: Five red fire extinguisher icons standing in a row, each with a blank label plate and a different simple pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 常见灭火器有五种。

shots.scene: 国外瓶颈有彩色色带的灭火器，旁边是国内看铭牌的放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Two extinguisher icons: one with a colored band around the neck, and one with a magnifying glass over its blank label plate. No people.
shots.narration: 国外常用色带区分，国内看铭牌标注。

shots.scene: 水型灭火器喷向燃烧的木块
shots.prompt_en: A water extinguisher icon spraying onto a burning wood block icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 水型：适合A类固体火。

shots.scene: 水喷向带电设备、油锅、气瓶，都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: water spraying onto a live electrical panel, onto a burning frying pan and onto a gas cylinder flame. No people.
shots.narration: 带电火、油锅火、气体火不能用水。

shots.scene: 泡沫覆盖在燃烧的木块和油盘上
shots.prompt_en: Foam covering a burning wood block and a burning liquid tray, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 泡沫：适合固体火和液体火。

shots.scene: 泡沫喷向带电设备、金属火、油锅，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: foam on a live electrical panel, on a burning metal chunk and on a burning frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 带电、金属和油锅火，不用泡沫。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器旁边是A、B、C三个类别图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher icon next to three class icons, a wood block, a liquid drop and a gas cloud, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉：固体、液体、气体火都能用。

shots.scene: 干粉喷向小型电器，旁边有仪器损坏的裂纹图标
shots.prompt_en: Powder spraying onto a small electrical instrument, with a crack icon showing the instrument gets damaged. No people.
shots.narration: 能扑低压电器火，但粉末会损坏仪器。

shots.scene: 干粉喷向油锅被打叉，高压电图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: powder on a burning frying pan and a high-voltage warning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 油锅火和高压带电设备，不用干粉。

shots.scene: 干粉粒子把连环箭头打断
shots.prompt_en: Powder particles break a chain of looping arrows apart. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉还能打断燃烧的链式反应。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器带喇叭形喷筒，喷向电脑和溶剂盘
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher icon with a horn-shaped nozzle spraying onto a computer and a solvent tray, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳：适合电器火和液体火。

shots.scene: 精密仪器图标旁打勾，没有残留
shots.prompt_en: A precision instrument icon with a green check and no residue on it. No people.
shots.narration: 不留残渣，适合精密仪器。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳喷向金属块和油锅被打叉，纸堆旁有复燃图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons crossed out with red X marks: carbon dioxide on a burning metal chunk and on a burning frying pan; a paper pile shows a small flame coming back. No people.
shots.narration: 金属火、油锅火不能用，固体火易复燃。

shots.scene: 手握喇叭筒的图标被打叉，旁边有雪花
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand gripping the horn nozzle with a snowflake beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 喷射时别握喇叭筒，防冻伤。

shots.scene: 湿式化学灭火器喷向油锅，油面被盖住
shots.prompt_en: A wet chemical extinguisher icon spraying onto a burning frying pan; the oil surface gets covered with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 湿式化学：专门扑烹饪油火。

shots.scene: 湿式化学灭火剂喷向液体、金属、带电设备被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: wet chemical on a solvent tray, on a burning metal chunk and on a live electrical panel. No people.
shots.narration: 液体火、金属火和带电火不用它。

shots.scene: 四面体的四个面依次被抽掉
shots.prompt_en: The four faces of a fire tetrahedron icon pop out one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火，就是拿掉四要素中的一个。

shots.scene: 水流浇在火上，温度计指针下降
shots.prompt_en: Water pours onto a flame and a thermometer icon beside it drops. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却法：带走热量，比如用水。

shots.scene: 管道阀门被拧紧，火焰变小熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon turns a pipe valve closed and the flame at the end of the pipe shrinks and goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离法：断掉燃料，比如关闭阀门。

shots.scene: 可燃物被移离火源
shots.prompt_en: Boxes and solvent bottles are moved away from a small flame with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 把旁边的可燃物移开，也是隔离。

shots.scene: 盖子扣住燃烧的烧杯，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A lid is placed over a burning beaker and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 窒息法：隔绝氧气，盖住它。

shots.scene: 灭火毯覆盖火焰；二氧化碳云团包围火焰
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a fire blanket covering a small flame, and a carbon dioxide cloud surrounding a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火毯、二氧化碳都是窒息。

shots.scene: 化学灭火剂粒子插进连环箭头，链条断开
shots.prompt_en: Chemical agent particles wedge into a chain of looping arrows and the chain breaks. No people.
shots.narration: 抑制法：用化学灭火剂打断链式反应。

shots.scene: 欣欣摆手纠正，旁边是二氧化碳和毯子图标指向窒息
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wags a finger; arrows from a carbon dioxide cloud icon and a blanket icon point to the oxygen face, not the chain face.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳和毯子主要是窒息，不是抑制。

shots.scene: 小研站在灭火器旁，四个步骤图标出现
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands next to a fire extinguisher; four step icons appear beside her.
shots.narration: 用灭火器，记住四步。

shots.scene: 手指拔出保险销的特写
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a hand pulling the safety pin out of an extinguisher handle. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，拔掉保险销。

shots.scene: 喷嘴对准火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: The extinguisher nozzle is aimed at the base of a small flame on a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，喷嘴对准火焰根部。

shots.scene: 手压下压把，喷出灭火剂
shots.prompt_en: A hand squeezes the extinguisher lever and agent sprays out. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，用力压下压把。

shots.scene: 喷流左右扫动，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The spray sweeps from side to side across the base of the flame until it goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，左右扫射，直到扑灭。

shots.scene: 小研先看了一眼着火物，再选灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student glances at a small burning solvent tray, then picks the matching extinguisher from the wall.
shots.narration: 先看清烧的是什么，再选灭火器。

shots.scene: 人站在火焰外一段距离，身后有通向门口的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram stands at a safe distance from a small fire, upwind, with an arrow behind leading to the exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 保持安全距离，站上风，背后留退路。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白检查卡站在灭火器前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a wall-mounted extinguisher holding a blank inspection card.
shots.narration: 灭火器要定期检查。

shots.scene: 压力表指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: A close view of an extinguisher pressure gauge with the needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 压力表指针要在绿区。

shots.scene: 保险销、软管、喷嘴、压把依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: On an extinguisher drawing the safety pin, hose, nozzle and handle light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 看销子、软管、喷嘴和压把。

shots.scene: 筒体和日期标签高亮，锈蚀的筒体被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The extinguisher body and a blank date label light up; a rusted dented extinguisher beside it is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看有效期，筒体有无锈蚀变形。

shots.scene: 推车式灭火器的轮子高亮
shots.prompt_en: A wheeled fire extinguisher cart with its wheels and hose highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 推车式的，还要看推车。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白检查记录上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank inspection record on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 周期按本单位规定，发现问题就报修。

shots.scene: 实验台上溶剂瓶远离加热板
shots.prompt_en: On a lab bench, solvent bottles are placed well away from a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 预防最重要：易燃物远离热源。

shots.scene: 台面上只放少量溶剂，大瓶放在防火柜里
shots.prompt_en: Only a small bottle of solvent sits on the bench while larger bottles are stored in a flammables cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 台面少放，多余的放回防火柜。

shots.scene: 无人看管的加热板图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hot plate heating a flask in an empty lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热时人不离开。

shots.scene: 明火加热易燃液体的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open flame heating a flask of flammable liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用明火直接加热易燃液体。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀口冒火的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas cylinder with a flame at the regulator. No people.
shots.narration: 气体着火，最要紧的是断气源。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套关闭总阀，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, closes the main gas valve on the wall and the small flame at the burner goes out.
shots.narration: 能安全关阀，就先关阀。

shots.scene: 只灭火不关阀的图标被打叉，旁边有气体云
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an extinguisher putting out a gas flame while gas keeps leaking into a cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只灭火不断气，泄漏的气体更危险。

shots.scene: 关不了阀时，人员撤离、关门
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms leave the lab and the door closes behind them, with a phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 关不了阀，立即撤离报警。

shots.scene: 小研用灭火毯盖住着火的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers a small burning beaker on the bench with a fire blanket.
shots.narration: 烧杯里的小火，用灭火毯盖住。

shots.scene: 盖住后人退开，不急着掀开
shots.prompt_en: The fire blanket stays over the beaker while she steps back and waits. No people.
shots.narration: 盖住后先别急着掀开。

shots.scene: 衣物着火：停、躺、滚三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a person pictogram stopping, dropping to the floor and rolling, with small flames going out. No people.
shots.narration: 身上着火别跑，就地躺下打滚。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志和喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above an emergency shower with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 附近有紧急喷淋，马上冲淋。

shots.scene: 小火图标打勾，大火浓烟图标指向门口
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a small flame with a green check and an extinguisher, and a large fire with thick smoke and an arrow pointing to the exit. No people.
shots.narration: 初起小火能灭就灭，火大了马上撤。

shots.scene: 大家弯腰低姿，用湿毛巾捂口鼻沿疏散标志撤离
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student crouch low, covering nose and mouth with wet cloths, and follow emergency exit signs.
shots.narration: 低姿前进，捂住口鼻，沿标志撤离。

shots.scene: 电梯图标被打叉，楼梯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An elevator icon crossed out with a red X next to a staircase icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 走楼梯，不坐电梯。

shots.scene: 人群在集合点集合，老周清点人数
shots.prompt_en: Students gather at an outdoor assembly point and the older man counts heads.
shots.narration: 到集合点清点人数，不回头取东西。

shots.scene: 阿杰拨打电话，旁边是火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls on a phone next to a flame icon.
shots.narration: 火警电话119。

shots.scene: 地点、着火物、有无被困三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a map pin, a burning bottle and a person behind a door. No people.
shots.narration: 说清地点、烧的什么、有没有人被困。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接电话，旁边是老周的电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone call; a second phone icon shows a call to the lab supervisor.
shots.narration: 同时报告保卫处和实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 红十字电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，拨打120。

shots.scene: 疏散通道被纸箱堵住，被打叉；通道畅通的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a corridor blocked by boxes crossed out with a red X, and a clear corridor with an emergency exit sign and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 疏散通道和安全出口，不能堵。

shots.scene: 防火门被木楔撑开，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fire door propped open with a wedge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防火门保持关闭，不能撑开锁死。

shots.scene: 灭火器被拿去当门挡，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fire extinguisher used as a door stop, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器不挪用、不遮挡。

shots.scene: 王老师带大家认识楼层消防器材位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the young male student and the female graduate student where the fire extinguisher, fire hose cabinet and alarm button are on their floor.
shots.narration: 第一天就要认清器材和出口位置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现火四面体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating fire tetrahedron icon.
shots.narration: 四要素缺一个，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 六类火的图标
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: wood, liquid drop, gas cloud, metal bar, lightning bolt and frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 先认清是哪类火。

shots.scene: 五种灭火器图标，铭牌高亮
shots.prompt_en: Five extinguisher icons with their blank label plates highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 看铭牌选灭火器，用错会更糟。

shots.scene: 四步手势图标
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons: pull a pin, aim, squeeze and sweep. No people.
shots.narration: 拔销、对准、压把、扫射。

shots.scene: 关阀、灭火毯、撤离箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closing valve, a fire blanket and an exit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 气体先断气，小火盖住，火大就撤。

shots.scene: 电话图标，119和120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame icon and a red cross icon. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣把灭火器放回墙上挂架，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places the fire extinguisher back on its wall bracket and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 防患未然，遇火不慌，再见！
